description: A glass box at the back of the lot, lit bright enough to read a map by from the road. Two short aisles, a coffee urn with a burnt ring in its drip tray, a sweating chiller, and a till bolted through the counter. A card by the door: NO PUMP IS EVER BROKEN. IT IS ALWAYS THE CARD. The floor is gritty.

window.description: A glazed shopfront facing the pumps, so whoever is behind the counter can see exactly who's filling what, and roughly how much of it they intend to pay for.
window.name: the shopfront glass

name: Flash Point Convenience
